identification: Rado DiaStar 'Integral' Jubile, vintage (c.1990s) black high-tech ceramic and gold-tone rectangular watch: black ceramic case with gold-tone frame round the dial, sapphire crystal, black ceramic link bracelet with gold-tone steel spacer lines, folding clasp. Black dial with RADO, gold 'jubile' script, Rado anchor at 6 and four small diamond hour markers (12, 3, 6, 9), gold baton hands. No date window visible (the cloud scan's 'date window at 6' is the anchor logo). Quartz (Integral Jubile is quartz-only). Most likely the 160.0281.3 / 160.0282.3 family (about 24-27mm wide, sold as both unisex and men's) or the larger 152.0xxx gents; size and reference cannot be read from the single front photo.
